brief:
Israeli forces intensified operations at Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The escalation marks a significant heightening of confrontations at the disputed holy site, which sits at the center of longstanding Israeli-Palestinian disputes over Jerusalem.

Details of the specific military actions and the scale of the deployment were not immediately available. The incident comes amid a pattern of rising tensions at the mosque compound, one of Islam's holiest sites and a location of repeated clashes between Israeli security forces and Palestinian worshippers in recent years.
title: Israeli forces escalate operations at Al-Aqsa Mosque
